_comment: Example momentum-lag experiment config.  All values are EXPERIMENTAL — not validated strategy parameters.
name: momentum-lag-v1
description: First-pass sweep of BTC momentum vs Kalshi repricing lag hypothesis. Tests whether short-term BTC moves toward a contract's winning side, combined with muted contract repricing, predict further contract repricing over 30-120 second windows.
hypothesis: When BTC moves at least $20 toward a contract's winning side over a 30-second window, but the contract ask has risen by no more than 3 cents during the same window, the contract tends to reprice further in the same direction over the next 30-120 seconds.
